visual_review.review_method: Actual inspection of the 300 dpi Poppler PDF render alongside the unchanged current Fig1 PNG reference
findings: Both A and B panels are complete and retain the original plotted participant points, connecting lines, cohort means and confidence intervals.
The y-axis title and 0–100 scale, eight method labels, percentage annotations and bottom legend are complete and legible.
No clipped labels, missing glyphs, overlapped labels or cropped graph elements were observed.
Arial glyph outlines from the existing SVG were retained; no font substitution was required.

export_warning_interpretation: Inkscape could not write its profile/cache directories and ran with default settings. Export returned zero, PDF parsing and rendering succeeded, and actual visual review confirmed the existing outlined SVG content was preserved.
scope: Repair of the Fig1 PDF export and two identical verification records only. The source SVG, numerical data, manuscript sources, DOCX and manuscript PDFs, TIFF/PNG figures, scripts, ZIP files and package manifests were not edited by this repair.
